product_summary: Website gattuwala.com (title: 'Gattuwala Energy Solutions Private Limited') presents the firm as 'India's Leading Manufacturer & Exporter of Biomass Pellets, Briquettes and High-Performance Machinery'. Concrete catalogue items read on the site: Gattuwala 8th-gen vertical ring-die pellet machine GTW7 series; Yulong 8th-gen centrifugal pellet machine; Yulong hammer machine; Gattuwala hammer machine; Yulong paddy-stalk crusher; flash dryer; saw-dust making machine; wood chipper; Z-elevator; conveyor belt; screw conveyor; vibrator/sieve; cooling tower; blender mixer; spare parts (roller assembly, roller shell, ring die). Separate product lines: biomass pellets, biomass briquettes, hardwood lump charcoal (BBQ/restaurant/industrial, claimed global export), plus service lines CBG (compressed biogas) plants, industrial solar, industrial gas plants, gas producer plant, plasma gasifier / plasma arc gasification waste. Raw-material page lists agri residues (rice husk, groundnut shell, bagasse, sawdust, napier grass etc.) as feedstock, not as traded goods. No prices, no HS codes and no customs/B-L references anywhere on the pages read.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — self-described manufacturer with own factory (MIDC Phase 3&4, Akola, Maharashtra) and '400+ plants established', but the catalogue is heavily branded 'Yulong' (Chinese-origin pellet-mill technology) alongside own 'Gattuwala GTW7' line, which is a typical import-and-rebadge / OEM-distribution pattern; also sells consumable fuel (pellets, briquettes, charcoal) and EPC services. Trader signs present, so role is mixed, not pure manufacturer.
comment: HS 847989 is only partially corroborated. It is a plausible residual heading for the pellet presses, hammer mills, mixers, sieves and conveyors, but the site's dominant declared activity — biomass pellets, briquettes and hardwood lump charcoal — is a FUEL/commodity business that 847989 does not cover at all: those goods belong in 4401.31/4401.39 (wood pellets), 4401.40 (agglomerated briquettes) and 4402.20 (wood charcoal). The charcoal page explicitly claims global export to Asia, Middle East, Europe and North America, so if charcoal or pellets are the actual shipped goods, the declared code is wrong for the shipment even though the company is legitimate. Additional lines missing from the declaration: feed pellet machines (8436.10), flash dryer (8419.89), gas producer/plasma gasifier and CBG plant equipment (heading not determinable from the site), industrial solar equipment. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the real sector is biomass/renewable-energy machinery and solid biofuels (agro-waste processing), with no oil, gas or chemical product found on the site. State: the claimed Delhi location matches only the corporate/marketing office (Pitampura/Aerocity, New Delhi); the registered head office and factory are in Akola, Maharashtra, and there are branch offices in Raipur (Chhattisgarh) and Indore (MP) — so 'Delhi' is at best a sales office, not the operating base. Per project rule 3 this HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: keep the company, correct the code to the actual shipped line (machinery 8479.89/8479.30 if machines are shipped; 4402.20 / 4401.31 / 4401.40 if fuel is shipped) and record verdict as accepted_hs_corrected. Everything above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, B-L, invoice or shipment record was found or read — the site's claims of being a 'leading exporter' and of '400+ plants' are marketing statements only, and no export or domestic supply evidence was verified in this pass (out of scope for this role). No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment data was researched or invented; PAN AAKCG2191B and legal name were taken as given and not verified.
